title: Date presets
cleanup: Leave preset on **Specific Map** when finished.

steps.name: Select Summer Map
steps.do: In the map controls dropdown, choose **Summer Map**.

steps.name: Summer date control
steps.do: Observe the date field near the map preset control.
steps.expect: Date input is hidden or not used for free picking (summer uses fixed seasonal anchor).

steps.name: Summer markers context
steps.do: Note animal/amenity marker set and Explore **Updates** if shown.
steps.expect: Map content reflects summer context (differs from mid-winter where species/amenities are seasonal).

steps.name: Winter date control
steps.do: Observe the date field near the map preset control.
steps.expect: Date field is hidden or not used for free picking (winter uses fixed seasonal anchor).

steps.name: Winter vs summer difference
steps.do: Compare markers/Updates to what you saw on Summer Map.
steps.expect: At least some seasonal difference is visible (animals, closed exhibits, updates, or Zoomobile season) — note what changed.

steps.name: Select Specific Map
steps.expect: Preset switches; date field becomes available.

steps.name: Pick mid-season date
steps.do: Choose a mid-season date (e.g. a day in May or September).

steps.name: Refresh for that date
steps.do: Watch markers and Updates/Events after the date change.
steps.expect: Markers and Updates/Events refresh for the selected date without requiring a full page reload.
